own_summary.heading: Summary of the investigation and outcomes

sentences.text: IBAC’s Operation Clara investigated whether a Victorian Planning Authority director misused his position or improperly influenced officials involved in the East Werribee project.
sentences.support: misused his public position on the board of the VPA to favour the Australian Education City

sentences.text: It examined the director’s lobbying for the Australian Education City consortium, conflicts of interest and attempts to obtain financial benefits.
sentences.support: sought to use his public position on the board of the VPA to favour AEC

sentences.text: IBAC found that the director lobbied officials without declaring relevant conflicts or registering the consortium as a client, and sought to use his board role to advance private interests.
sentences.support: IBAC’s investigation found that Mr Theophanous sought to use his public position

sentences.text: It made four recommendations covering board appointments, lobbying restrictions, directors’ conduct rules and the time limit for commencing certain planning authority prosecutions.
sentences.support: prohibit public entity board directors from engaging in lobbying activities on any matter that relates to the functions of the public entity

findings.quote: IBAC’s investigation found that Mr Theophanous sought to use his public position on the board of the VPA to favour AEC and further his other business interests as a registered lobbyist.
IBAC’s investigation did not identify any direct financial payments from AEC to Mr Theophanous.

notes: The summary uses a role rather than a name. The report distinguishes unsuccessful attempts to secure direct payment from indirect benefits; no adverse finding about the candidate or consortium is implied.
